answer_1.quote: We apply the proposed approach to language modeling, unaligned style transfer and dialog-response generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences, transferred sentiment sentences, dialog responses

answer_2.quote: To benchmark language modeling performance, we report the ELBO and Perplexity (PPL) of APo-VAE and baselines.

answer_4.quote: We further perform human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk. We asked the turkers to compare generated responses from two models, and assess each model's informative-ness, relevance to the dialog context (coherence), and diversity.
answer_4.guideline: assess each model's informative-ness, relevance to the dialog context (coherence), and diversity
